title: Weak Schur number WS(8), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 8 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z with x != y, with n as large as possible; it shows WS(8) >= n. The best known lower bound is WS(8) >= 6976, by Rowley (2020); a colouring of 1..6977 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..7 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves WS(8) >= n (larger is better)

best_known.source: WS(8) >= 6976: Rowley (2020), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Leaps in Bounds, Schur and weak Schur numbers
